prompt: Build me a new map and use it as a background for a new marketing banner for the new city title
refined_prompt: Flat 2D vector illustration, no outlines or strokes, solid #e0dfe6 background. A fantasy-style treasure map aesthetic reimagined in flat vector. Parchment area rendered as large white #ffffff rectangle with folded corner, placed right of center as focal hero element. On it, a detailed flat city map with winding streets in #c8c7ce, building clusters in near-black #2d2d2d arranged in medieval quarter patterns, a teal-cyan #4ecdc4 castle icon at the center, and small geometric trees as parks. A large compass rose in teal occupies the lower-right. Surrounding the map on the grey background are scattered minimal icons: stars, location pins in #3ab5a8. Left third kept sparse with only subtle pin markers, clean safe zone for text overlay. Zero gradients, hard geometric fills, playful bright mood, compact micro-detail, pure vector.
